'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Garrett Larson LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Garrett Larson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Informal typed/hand sheet. Title I'm that guy. Republic Trooper x12 package. Shields mixed into list (leading dashes). Klor Slug (V) on sheet omitted pending card-name QA. Klor' Slug (V) linked as Virtual Sets era card.

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
